language.label: Language
app.tagline: An AI team for your game and your code
role.commander.name: Commander
role.commander.summary: Takes a goal, splits it into tasks and hands them to each role. Never does the work itself.
role.commander.duty2: Picks the right role for each task
role.builder.name: Builder
role.builder.summary: Places blocks, building walls and shelters from materials in the inventory.
role.miner.name: Miner
role.miner.summary: Mines ore, gathers wood and materials, and crafts what the team needs.
role.defender.name: Defender
role.defender.summary: Protects the team from monsters. Never attacks players.
role.explorer.name: Explorer
role.explorer.summary: Walks around the area and reports what is nearby.
role.coder.name: Full-Stack Developer
role.coder.summary: Writes code on a separate branch and researches, then sends it to you to review.
role.coder.duty1: Writes code on its own Git branch
agent.problemDetail: See why on the Task Board
agent.notInGameDetail: Joins by itself when given a task
goal.title: What should the team do today?
goal.subtitle: Describe a goal in plain words. {name} will split it up for each role.
goal.label: Goal
goal.placeholder.minecraft: For example, build a small house near spawn and guard it at night
goal.placeholder.code: For example, add login to auth.ts
goal.placeholder.research: For example, summarize where the database is slow
goal.sample.minecraft1: Build a small house near spawn
goal.sample.code2: Write tests for the main function
goal.sample.research1: Summarize where the database is slow
goal.noWorkspace: Choose a project folder before giving code work.
plan.started: The team has started. Follow along on the team chart below.
plan.check: Check it first. Nobody starts until you say so.
plan.aiFailed: AI planning failed, so this is one task for now: {error}
chart.title: Team chart
feed.title: Recent activity
feed.empty: Nothing yet. Try your first goal above.
tasks.title: Task Board
tasks.subtitle: See how far each task has got and who owns it.
review.changedFiles: {name} changed {count} files on a separate branch. Your project has not changed.
review.noContent: No content changed, for example a moved or empty file.
review.autoRunTitle: Check these files with extra care
review.autoRunBody: because they run by themselves later, such as during install or deploy:
review.truncated: This change is too long to show in full. See all of it with Git on branch
review.mergedBody: The changes are now in your project.
review.sentBackBody: The task is back in To do. Your note goes to the AI when it starts again.
review.notRun: The team has not run this code or its tests. Read it before approving.
review.taskGone: This task is gone, possibly because the app was closed.
review.wrongBranch: This work came from branch {base}, but the project is on {current}. Switch back and try again.
review.mergeFailed: Could not merge. Your project is unchanged and the work is kept on branch {branch}: {detail}
review.noChanges: The AI did not propose any file changes.
review.identical: The files the AI wrote match what is already there, so there is nothing to review.
team.title: Team & Roles
team.subtitle: A role decides what each member can do. Work outside it is refused.
team.brainHint: If that provider has no API key, the team's main AI is used instead.
team.swapped: {name} is now the Commander, and {previous} became {role}.
team.busy: {name} is working. Wait for it to finish before changing roles.
team.needCommander: The team always needs a Commander. Choose someone else first and the roles will swap.
team.commanderBusy: The Commander is planning. Wait for it to finish.
log.title: Work log
server.title: Connect to a server
server.subtitle: Choose a server, test it, then send the team in.
server.localDetail: Running here, on your LAN, or on your own port
server.publicDetail: A public IP or domain with many real players
server.addressLabel: IP or domain, a port can go on the end
server.postJoin: Commands after joining, one per line
server.postJoinHint: Stored encrypted and never written to logs.
server.lockedHint: Take every bot out before changing the server.
server.noCrew: Nobody is on the in-game crew. Assign roles on the Team page.
server.msHint: Open the Microsoft page and enter this code. The app never sees your password.
server.rulesTitle: Read the server's rules before connecting
server.rulesBody: Many big servers ban bots, and the account can be banned. This mode joins one bot at a time, limits chat, and does not dig while walking.
server.commandersBody: Bots only take orders from names on this list.
server.whisperHint: or whisper to a bot to order it directly
server.spoofWarning: On a server without premium IDs or a login plugin, someone else could use the same name to pose as a commander.
server.chatFailed: No bot is online, or the chat queue is full.
server.reflexes: Survive automatically, such as raising a shield or swapping a totem
watch.title: Watch
watch.subtitle: See an AI team from anywhere, without running a server yourself.
watch.remoteTitle: Watch a team on another server
watch.remoteBody: Enter the IP of a server whose owner shares its status. You can only look, and you do not need your own server.
watch.needsKey: This server needs a key. Ask its owner.
watch.rateLimited: Too many requests. Trying again in 30 seconds.
watch.mcUp: The Minecraft server is up: {version} · players {online}/{max}
watch.shareBody: Opens a read-only web page for others. It contains no API keys, server addresses, accounts or chat, and nobody can give orders from it.
watch.showCoords: Show bot coordinates (viewers will know where your base is)
watch.firewall: People outside your LAN need port {port} open on your router or firewall. This connection is not encrypted, so use HTTPS through a reverse proxy on the open internet.
watch.noViewer: No MineOffice status page found at {base}. The owner needs to turn on sharing and open this port.
settings.title: AI Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose the team's main AI. All keys are stored encrypted on this computer only.
provider.openrouter.note: Can start free, good for trying things out
provider.ollama.name: Ollama on this computer
provider.ollama.note: No key needed, runs on your own computer
workspace.title: Project for code work
workspace.body: The AI only works inside this folder, on its own branch. Your files change only when you approve.
workspace.advice: Use a folder for one project, or let the app create a new one. Do not use your Desktop, Documents, or MineOffice itself.
workspace.createNew: Create a new project for me
workspace.enableGit: Set up Git in this folder
workspace.state.readyChanges: Ready. On branch {branch}, with {count} uncommitted changes. A merge can fail if the AI edits those same files.
workspace.state.notGit: This folder does not use Git yet, so the AI cannot work here.
workspace.state.noCommits: This project has no first commit yet.
workspace.state.noGit: Git is not installed on this computer.
workspace.state.detached: This project is not on a branch. Switch to a branch first.
workspace.warn.tooBroad: This folder is too broad, such as your home, Desktop or a whole drive. The AI could read files you did not mean to share. Choose a folder for one project.
workspace.warn.isApp: This is MineOffice itself. The AI would be changing this program.
workspace.refuseBroad: This folder is too broad to set up. Choose a folder for one project.
workspace.tooManyFiles: This folder has too many files to set up automatically. Set up Git yourself, then choose it again.
workspace.notChosen: Choose a project folder first, under AI Settings.
workspace.notFound: Cannot find project folder {path}. Change it under AI Settings.
workspace.notRepo: Folder {path} does not use Git, or Git is not installed. Change it under AI Settings.
workspace.noFirstCommit: This project has no first commit yet. Make one and try again.
workspace.detached: The project is not on a branch. Switch to a branch and try again.
setup.brainBody: You can change it later, and set one per member on the Team page.
setup.keyHint: Stored encrypted on this computer only.
setup.whereBody: Not playing Minecraft? You can skip this.
setup.localDetail: This computer, your LAN, or your own port
setup.publicDetail: A public IP or domain. Read its rules on bots first
setup.doneBody: Give your first goal from the Command Center.
setup.noKey: No API key yet, so the team cannot plan or work. Add one later under AI Settings.
viewer.readOnly: View only. Nobody can give orders from this page.
viewer.enterKey: Enter the key to view status
viewer.askOwner: Get the key from the server owner.
viewer.rateLimited: Too many requests. Trying again shortly.
error.hostRequired: Enter the server's IP or domain.
error.portInvalid: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
error.usernameInvalid: The name must be 3-16 characters, using only A-Z, 0-9 and _.
error.msAccountRequired: Enter the Microsoft email or account name.
error.refused: Cannot connect to {address}. The server may be off, or the port may be wrong.
error.notFound: Cannot find {host}. Check the IP or domain.
error.needsPremium: This server needs a premium ID. Switch this bot to Premium (Microsoft).
error.whitelist: This account is not on the server's whitelist.
error.banned: This account is banned from the server: {detail}
error.throttled: The server limits how often you can join. Waiting before trying again.
error.version: Version does not match the server: {detail}
error.noMinecraft: This Microsoft account does not own Minecraft: Java Edition.
error.joinTimeout: Timed out waiting for the bot to join.
mcp.title: Outside tools (MCP)
mcp.body: Connect MCP servers to give in-game agents more tools, such as web search or your own programs. Tools ask for your approval unless you change it.
mcp.warning: Only add servers you trust. A local server runs as a program on this computer.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameInvalid: The name can only use letters, numbers, - and _.
mcp.fieldRequired: Fill in the command or URL.
permission.title: An agent wants to use a tool
permission.body: {name} is waiting for your answer. Check what it is about to send.
settings.openaiBaseUrl: Custom address (optional), for LM Studio, Groq and other OpenAI-compatible services
role.product_manager.name: Product Manager
role.product_manager.summary: Turns your goal into clear requirements, and checks what is in and out of scope.
role.product_manager.duty2: Sets how to tell a feature is done
role.business_analyst.name: Business Analyst
role.business_analyst.summary: Researches users, rules and similar products, then makes recommendations.
role.ux_designer.name: UX Designer
role.ux_designer.summary: Designs how it works: journeys, screens, states and wording.
role.ux_designer.duty1: Maps out user journeys and screens
role.ux_designer.duty2: Writes the wording and error states
role.ui_designer.name: UI Designer
role.ui_designer.summary: Designs how it looks, and matches the pictures you show the team.
role.ui_designer.duty2: Follows the style of your images
role.architect.name: Software Architect
role.architect.summary: Decides the technical structure, so others can build the parts separately.
role.tech_lead.name: Tech Lead
role.tech_lead.summary: Reads the team's code and sends it back when it is not good enough.
role.tech_lead.duty1: Reviews every change in a project
role.tech_lead.duty2: Takes on the hardest shared code
role.frontend.name: Frontend Developer
role.frontend.summary: Builds what people see and use.
role.backend.name: Backend Developer
role.backend.summary: Builds servers, APIs and business logic.
role.mobile.name: Mobile Developer
role.mobile.duty2: Handles small screens and weak networks
role.data_engineer.name: Data Engineer
role.data_engineer.summary: Designs databases, migrations and data pipelines.
role.data_engineer.duty2: Writes migrations that lose no data
role.ml_engineer.name: AI/ML Engineer
role.ml_engineer.summary: Adds AI features: models, prompts and ways to measure quality.
role.devops.name: DevOps Engineer
role.devops.summary: Sets up builds, CI, deployment and monitoring.
role.security.name: Security Engineer
role.security.summary: Finds and fixes security problems before release.
role.qa.name: QA Engineer
role.qa.summary: Writes test plans and automated tests. It cannot run them, so you run them.
role.tech_writer.name: Technical Writer
role.tech_writer.summary: Writes the README, guides and documentation.
role.tech_writer.duty1: Writes how to install and use it
goal.placeholder.project: Describe the program you want. The team will plan, design, build and check it.
goal.sample.project1: Build a booking website for a small cafe
goal.sample.project2: Make a simple expense tracker app
goal.imagesHint: Show the team a design you like, or paste an image. Your AI model must be able to read images.
goal.imageTooMany: You can attach up to {count} images.
plan.projectHint: You approve the requirements and design. The team then builds and reviews its own work, and you review the finished result once.
approval.title: Check this before the team builds on it
approval.body: {name} finished this. Approve it, or say what you want changed.
approval.noteRequired: Say what should change, so the team knows what to do.
swarm.finalSummary: The team finished {count} tasks and changed {files} files. Nothing has been run, so test it after merging.
swarm.noNote: The user did not say what to change. Look for real problems and fix them.
server.officeInWorldHint: They stand in the world and report in chat. Each one uses more memory. They never join public servers.
role.admin.name: Office Administrator
role.admin.summary: Keeps the office running: schedules, checklists, follow-ups and reports.
role.customer_support.name: Customer Support
role.customer_support.summary: Drafts replies to customers, FAQs and help guides. You send them.
role.social_media.name: Social Media Manager
role.social_media.summary: Plans posting calendars and writes posts for each platform. You post them.
role.content_writer.name: Content Writer
role.content_writer.summary: Writes articles, captions, newsletters and web copy.
role.content_writer.duty2: Keeps to the tone you want
role.marketer.name: Marketing Specialist
role.marketer.summary: Plans campaigns, target audiences, SEO keywords and ad copy.
role.marketer.duty2: Writes SEO keywords and ad copy
role.graphic_designer.name: Graphic Designer
role.graphic_designer.summary: Draws logos, icons, banners and posters as SVG files you can open and edit.
role.video_producer.name: Video Producer
role.video_producer.summary: Writes video scripts, storyboards and subtitles. It does not edit or render video.
goal.sample.project3: Plan a month of Facebook posts for a cafe, and draw a logo
